_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Sound Test Failure Notification and Recommendations Report
summary: The Sound Test Failure Notification and Recommendations Report aids the Government in deciding whether to accept equipment that fails to meet airborne sound or structureborne vibratory acceleration criteria.
use_relationship:
The Sound Test Failure Notification and Recommendations Report aids the Government in deciding whether to accept an equipment item which fails to meet airborne sound criteria or structureborne vibratory acceleration criteria.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and preparation instructions for that data generated as specified in MIL-STD-1474.
b. This DID supersedes DI-HFAC-80271.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Sound Test Failure Notification and Recommendations Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Sound Test Failure Notification and Recommendations Report shall contain the following sections.

children.title: Introductory information.
children.content: This section shall contain a statement that the equipment failed to meet the airborne sound criteria, the structureborne vibratory acceleration criteria, and if applicable, both criteria.

children.title: Test and equipment information.
children.content: This section shall contain the following:

children.title: Equipment to be evaluated, including contract number.
Ship name(s) and hull number(s), if known, for which the unit is being acquired.
Driven and driver unit manufacturers and serial numbers.
Equipment specification acceptance criteria (airborne sound pressure levels, structureborne vibratory acceleration levels, or both).
Tabular or graphic records of the data from the test and from the retests of modified equipment.
Documentation of specific actions taken to correct the equipment sound levels, acceleration levels, or both.
Identification of the cause of the failure(s).
Specific recommendations for design modifications or materiel changes which may permit the equipment to meet the criteria.
Estimated time to implement the design modifications described in 3.2.l above.
